The '''E-3 blaster''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] used by the time of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] carried one in an [[Limb/Legends|ankle]] [[Holster/Legends|holster]] in place of his ordinary twin [[BlasTech 4]] blasters<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' to [[3653 BBY]].</ref> He later carried one on his [[Zeerid Korr's farm|farm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] after he gave up [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], and had the blaster on him when a [[BT-7 Thunderclap|BT7 Thunderstrike]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] arrived at the location. Though Korr originally thought the ship was someone from the criminal [[organization]] the [[Exchange]] coming to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him for not fulfilling his obligations to them, it was instead his friend, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The E-3 blaster appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />
